name: The 80-Year Collapse
claim: A debt-driven collapse of the US economy is imminent — the '80-year big cycle' is ending. The predicted mechanism rotates with the news cycle; since mid-2026 it runs through the AI boom (debt-financed AI capex as the trigger).
born_note: Earliest ledger entry: Dalio's 'Fed risks repeating 1937' warning.

trigger.title: Ray Dalio: I Predicted The 2008 CRASH, I Know What Comes Next!
trigger.note: 135K views in its first 3 hours on 30 Jul 2026; 3.9M within a week. Published under a rotating title — first seen as 'Billionaires Warning: AI Will Lose You Money… You Should Be Happy' with 'The 80 Year Collapse Is Here' thumbnail. Audit verdict: a genuinely new interview, NOT a re-cut of the Sept 2025 DOAC episode — but its clips ecosystem invents figures around it (a '60% crash' title whose number never appears in the interview).

mutations.mechanism: Fed repeating 1937 — tightening into a downturn
'Phase 5' of the Big Debt Cycle — an 'economic heart attack' within ~3 years
capital war — money weaponized; gold as the hedge
AI capex as the crisis vector

explanations.layman: Some famous investors say America has borrowed so much money that a huge crash is coming. This warning has been around for 11 years — the crash keeps being predicted, and keeps not arriving on schedule. The reason given changes with the news: lately it's AI spending. Fear like this gets clicks, so YouTube is full of videos recycling it. We keep score: who predicted what, when, and whether they were right. So far the scoreboard shows repeated reschedules.
explanations.intermediate: The thesis: the US is at the end of a long debt cycle (~80 years), so a major crisis is imminent. Ray Dalio has carried this since 2015, but the predicted mechanism has mutated six times — 1937 analogy, debt supercycle, internal conflict, 'Phase 5', capital war, and now debt-financed AI capex. The ledger shows 2 refuted calls and 2 goalpost-moves; the first cleanly countable clock expires Sept 2028. The corpus is mostly derivative and recycled content — a mature narrative feeding a content economy rather than new analysis.
explanations.expert: An 11-year rolling-horizon narrative exhibiting the classic audit signatures: horizon-rolling (~2yr clocks re-issued since 2015), mechanism rotation tracking the news cycle (6 mutations), and monetization through hard-asset affiliates in the derivative layer. Verdict ratio (7 original / 38) marks late lifecycle — fragmentation-stage content dominates, with invented figures appearing in clip titles. Near-term tests: Dalio's midterm-conflict claim (Nov 2026) and the AI-capex strand, which is migrating toward the separate AI-bubble discourse. Directional debt risk is real; the ledger's job is precision about claims, clocks, and outcomes — not dismissal.
